cells.terminal_only: each cell's terminal attempt (D11.3: the first with a completed model exit); infrastructure attempts are not checked or counted

config_receipts.description: result.json config and the episode_setup event's config are the arm's record

final_response_recorded.description: each delivered final response has exactly one parsed_actions or format_error event at call_index 7

ledger_event.description: an episode that reached its last call (a final_turn_notice event) has exactly one evidence_ledger event, the row right before the final_turn_notice event, agreeing with the receipt (text sha256, suffix, entries, candidates, body bytes, appended, appended_to, tool_call_id, message sha256s) and with the frozen text format; computed is true; on: appended, and sent and delivered as the notice; off: never appended, sent or delivered. An episode that did not reach it has no event and the unbuilt receipt

ledger_receipts.description: result.json exposure.evidence_ledger equals accounting.evidence_ledger and the episode_finished event's, has exactly the receipt fields, mode = the arm and call_index 7

notice_receipts.description: the A1 final_turn_notice receipt is consistent (as the A1 dev check reads it)

records.description: each terminal attempt: its directory names its cell and attempt, result.json binds attempt_start.json and events.jsonl (sha256 and rows), its run_id is run.json's, and no attempt follows it

request_bytes.description: on: the delivered 8th request's last message ends with '\n\n[harness notice] ' + the ledger text + the deadline suffix, is the content the final_turn_notice event binds, and the ledger header occurs exactly once in the request (never in an earlier request); off: no request contains the header and the 8th request's last message ends with the deadline suffix alone

run_complete.description: every LEDGER seed-61 cell of cells.jsonl is terminal in the D11.3 sense (a completed attempt, or missing after 3 infrastructure attempts)

run_json_cells.description: cells.jsonl is the file run.json binds (cells_sha256)

run_json_episode_config.description: run.json episode_config is the arm's exact record (the six prereg fields, the deadline notice, evidence_ledger = the arm and evidence_ledger_rules)

selection.description: every dispatched cell is a LEDGER|<item>|vcomplete or omit_node|C1|s61 cell of cells.jsonl
